name: (Blackfrost Dead) Mindburning Gaze

source.title: Pathfinder #189: Dreamers of the Nameless Spires

text: The blackfrost dead fixes its terrifying gaze on a creature within 60 feet. The creature takes 1d4 mental per level of the blackfrost dead (minimum 2d4), with a basic Will save save. On a critical failure, the creature is Frightened 1.
